targets.recordKey: WHERE gen_agentsid = ? ('?' #1 -> Param_1 = gen_agentsid from 'Get agent Data' = gen_agents.gen_agentsid found by LEFT JOIN on the contract's gen_agentname)
targets.writeCondition: Rows of 'Get agent Data' (HAVING ABS(sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1) routed by Conditional Split 'Agent Or Agency' to output 'Update Agent' (EvaluationOrder 0, !ISNULL(gen_agentsid)). An agent that appears in several (agent, agency) pairs gets one UPDATE per pair; the last processed row wins (row order not determined). Data flow 'Update agents balance' runs after 'Create ETL Process record' (Success, DTSX:7072).
targets.expression: SET gen_agentvalue = ? ('?' #0 -> Param_0 = balance). balance = sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) (cy, written unchanged as gen_agentvalue) over the UNION ALL of (a) every gen_fundmain f JOIN gen_agentcontract ac ON ac.Gen_agentcontractId = f.gen_brokernumber, taking ac.gen_agentname / ac.gen_agencyname, and (b) the same funds JOIN the parent contract acc ON acc.Gen_agentcontractId = ac.gen_agencycontractnumber, taking acc.gen_agentname / acc.gen_agencyname; LEFT JOIN gen_agents ON gen_agentsid = agent_balance.gen_agentname, LEFT JOIN Gen_agencie ON gen_agencieid = agent_balance.gen_agencyname; GROUP BY gen_agentsid, gen_agencieid, gen_agentvalue, gen_agencyvalue; HAVING ABS(sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1. The sum is per (agent, agency) PAIR, not per agent/agency alone. No fund-level filter (no state / existinfile filter on gen_fundmain).

targets.mechanism: SQL (OLE DB Command: UPDATE Gen_agencieBase on [CRM] = Psql/ALTSHULER_MSCRM)
targets.recordKey: WHERE gen_agencieid = ? ('?' #1 -> Param_1 = gen_agencieid from 'Get agent Data' = Gen_agencie.gen_agencieid found by LEFT JOIN on the contract's gen_agencyname)
targets.writeCondition: Rows of 'Get agent Data' routed by Conditional Split 'Agent Or Agency' to output 'Update Agency' (EvaluationOrder 1, !ISNULL(gen_agencieid)). Conditional Split sends each row to the FIRST output whose condition is true: every row with a non-NULL gen_agentsid goes to 'Update Agent' (EvaluationOrder 0) even when gen_agencieid is also set, so an agency is updated ONLY from pairs whose agent is NULL (contract without agent, or agent id not found in gen_agents). All such rows have gen_agentsid NULL and therefore gen_agentvalue NULL, so GROUP BY (gen_agentsid, gen_agencieid, gen_agentvalue, gen_agencyvalue) yields exactly one group per agency: at most one UPDATE per agency per run. For these rows the HAVING reduces to ABS(sum + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1, so the agency is rewritten on every run whenever that holds, even if the stored value already equals the sum (DTSX:5061-5090).
targets.expression: SET gen_agencyvalue = ? ('?' #0 -> Param_0 = balance). balance = sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) (cy, written unchanged as gen_agencyvalue) over the UNION ALL of (a) every gen_fundmain f JOIN gen_agentcontract ac ON ac.Gen_agentcontractId = f.gen_brokernumber, taking ac.gen_agentname / ac.gen_agencyname, and (b) the same funds JOIN the parent contract acc ON acc.Gen_agentcontractId = ac.gen_agencycontractnumber, taking acc.gen_agentname / acc.gen_agencyname; LEFT JOIN gen_agents ON gen_agentsid = agent_balance.gen_agentname, LEFT JOIN Gen_agencie ON gen_agencieid = agent_balance.gen_agencyname; GROUP BY gen_agentsid, gen_agencieid, gen_agentvalue, gen_agencyvalue; HAVING ABS(sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1. The sum is per (agent, agency) PAIR, not per agent/agency alone. No fund-level filter (no state / existinfile filter on gen_fundmain). Because of the Conditional Split order, only the sum of pairs with NULL agent reaches this command.

notes.note: CRM DB proof: all writes use Package.ConnectionManagers[CRM] (DTSID {D51CCED1-9F31-4C56-840C-E21FF6667EC7}, DTSX:4; Data Source=Psql; Initial Catalog=ALTSHULER_MSCRM, DTSX:6). OLE DB Commands and the (disabled) Execute SQL Task write the Base tables directly (Unsupported); the two script components use the CRM SDK (Supported). ETL plumbing not mapped: Create ETL Process record, End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish, both 'ETL Warning 1' scripts (gen_etlprocesswarning), OnError\Error ETL Process record.

Execution order (precedence, all Success, DTSX:7071-7076): Get Variables From SystemConfigurarion -> Create ETL Process record -> Update agents balance -> Set Gen_commissionpostponed (DISABLED) -> update agents commissionpostponed field -> update agencies commissionpostponed field -> End ETL Process record.

Suspicious HAVING in 'Get agent Data' (DTSX:5090): ABS(sum(balance) - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1 - by operator precedence this is (sum - agentvalue) + agencyvalue, so the change detection mixes the agent and the agency value of the pair; a pair can be skipped although the stored value differs, or re-written although it is equal. gen_agentvalueDB / gen_agencyvalueDB are selected but not exposed as output columns (external metadata only, DTSX:5108-5112).

Balance granularity: the sum is grouped per (agent, agency) pair. gen_agentvalue / gen_agencyvalue therefore receive a PAIR sum; an agent with several pairs is updated several times and the last row wins (order not determined). Each fund balance is counted twice when the broker contract has a parent contract (once for ac, once for acc).

Conditional Split 'Agent Or Agency' (DTSX:5014): rows with both agent and agency non-NULL go only to 'Update Agent' (first true condition, EvaluationOrder 0); agencies are updated only from pairs with NULL agent. Rows with both NULL go to the Default output, which has no path (discarded).

Commission-postponed flows: the source WHERE 'gen_commissionpostponed != 1' excludes records with NULL gen_commissionpostponed (SQL three-valued logic), although the disabled SQL version explicitly handled NULL. Date checks use dateadd(HOUR,3,...) (fixed +3h, no DST) against SQL Server CONVERT(DATE, GETDATE()), while the Derived Column compares against SSIS host GETDATE().

Script exception path: an exception thrown by ExcecuteBulk() inside Input0_ProcessInputRow (main.cs:79-80, e.g. 'no response') is caught per row (main.cs:83-92); myEntities.Clear() (main.cs:117) is then skipped: the list keeps growing past 1000, the check myEntities.Count == 1000 (main.cs:79) never fires again, and all remaining entities are sent in one final ExecuteMultiple at EndOfRowset (main.cs:126-128); the outcome of a batch larger than 1000 depends on the external proxy / CRM server (not provable here). Rows sent to CastingError have no downstream path.
Script source analysed (C# main.cs embedded in the DTSX); compiled binaries and CRM2015.Proxy are not decompiled.

The original source column gen_pausereason (Gen_agents / Gen_agencie) appears in the lineage as the origin of the writer input gen_pausereason, but Derived Column 'set 'pausereason' field' replaces it for every row (expression never NULL); its value never reaches CRM. excludeFromValue with field null is used on gen_pausereason to demote that DB origin to influence (compose matches excludeFromValue by field; DB origins have field null and the only value-role DB chain of that attribute is the replaced original column). The written value is the literal 5 or 4 chosen by gen_licenseexpdate.
